stumbles.quote: Tilt the top of the phone away from you to accelerate.
stumbles.why: The phone is in landscape while driving, so it's unclear which edge is the "top". It could be the edge that was the top in portrait, or the edge facing away from you. The same doubt applies to the brake line.

stumbles.quote: Tilt left or right to steer.
stumbles.why: In landscape it's unclear whether this means rotating the phone like a steering wheel or tipping it sideways. Neither is stated.

point: You lock the phone in portrait, pick a track, laps and difficulty, then tap Start engine and turn to landscape. After that you steer by tilting and use forward and back tilt for throttle and brake, measured from the pose you hold when the start lights go out.
